name: Thijs Reuten, Nina Carberry - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report does not change any law. It is the European Parliament's opinion on how the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement is working. It asks the EU and the UK to keep implementing the agreement fully and to build on the new partnership agreed at their May 2025 summit. It calls for closer work on defence and security, energy, fishing, trade paperwork, data protection, research and student exchanges. It also asks the Commission to keep Parliament informed and to watch for the UK drifting away from EU standards.

**Key points**

- The Parliament wants a new security and defence partnership with the UK, plus regular summits and closer energy and carbon market links.
- It asks for less border paperwork, a food safety deal, fairer fishing access and easier travel and study for young people.
- It is only an opinion: the Commission and EU governments now decide whether to act on these requests.
